supporting_pages.title: "Connect to GitHub Enterprise \_|\_ Developer Connect \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Developer Connect creates the repository links and displays them in the Google Cloud console. gcloud Run the following command: gcloud developer-connect connections git-repository-links create REPO NAME \ --clone-uri = REPO URI \ --connection = CONNECTION NAME \ --location = REGION Replace the following: REPO NAME : a name for your repository link.
Add repository links to existing connections Once you have established a connection to GitHub Enterprise, you can link to repositories.
Developer Connect fetches your private key from GitHub and stores it in your Google Cloud project as a Secret Manager secret.
